The audit found an unrelated disconnected PPA reveal in s21; the current experiment base removes it, pending final acceptance.
Density-only ranking omits risk-bearing worst sections from acceptance protection.
Experiment-control protected dense frames lack claim-bound semantic overlays; annotations are the isolated repair factor.
The audit found that s21 overlay copy removed announcement, contract, and reported-status qualifiers; the current authored repair remains final-review pending.
Modeled eligibility does not yet enforce the full Pareto, continuity, live-browser, accessibility, and blind-review contract.
The synthetic current experiment control is not the immutable frozen champion and lacks historical viewport captures.
Release prose attributes frozen-champion browser approval to the pending challenger.
At 390x844, static gating did not estimate the full wrapped masthead plus focus-key fallback for every section, so shared overflow could pass undetected.
s02, s08, and s15 did not consistently make site evidence, product or design reference, and explicit unknowns visible in their questions and claims.
The s23 transition did not hand off explicitly to s24's physical conversion path and no-estimate stop rule.
Modeled eligibility was not derived from the complete gate evidence consumed by Pareto, so a pending or failed modeled gate could be misrepresented.
Saturation consumed historical YAML dispositions rather than current generated Pareto decisions, so stale decisions could control the loop.
Pareto protection cohorts could be empty or omit ordered handoff and shared-consumer members, allowing vacuous non-regression.
All-section non-regression did not fail closed over every section, viewport, risk flag, and protected metric.
YAML loading and evidence validation did not fail closed on duplicate keys and unknown or missing schema fields.
Frozen-champion verification did not fully reconstruct immutable Git-object artifacts and explicitly separate the absent historical captures.
s02, s08, and s15 ask for evidence distinctions that their focused teaching frames do not yet expose.
s01 preserves the permit posture but does not visibly refine it with confirmed installed presence and explicit configuration and operating unknowns.
Saturation treated two terminal rounds containing low-priority findings as clean.
Complete audit records could not encode or enforce exact five-viewport, 130-evaluation, and 25-transition coverage.
Four absolute render gates sampled only five protected sentinels, so a hard-constraint defect in another section could be represented as passed.
Evidence validation remained fail-open on material nested field types and unknown nested fields.
Six registered candidates existed across four hypotheses while only three received Pareto evaluation, forcing the unmatched candidates pending forever.
Generated-HTML prohibition and linked owner-to-source compatibility were declared but not enforced.
Three authored 2D frames crop four teaching labels across seven evaluations while the map evaluator clamps boxes and reports no label-clipping risk.
The new s01 annotation says the authorized ten-unit fleet totals 500 MW while its bound evidence establishes 360.5 MW.
The audit manifest validates policy keys but accepts and republishes fabricated live-evidence completion values.
Static validation accepted s01 annotation prose that contradicted the numeric facts of its sole bound claim.
Five annotated 3D scenes retain a fixed 390 px overlay at 1024x768, collapsing the scene to 312 px and forcing every spatial label into the fixed key.
The generated instructor packet omits the presenter-facing teaching annotations authored for sixteen sections.
The final overlay conflates power-rate versus energy-yield basis with training versus inference workload type.
A synthetic-control Pareto disposition is exposed as final acceptance without prerequisite-repair and frozen-champion evidence gates.
Priority validation accepts out-of-range severity, teaching-importance, and repair-risk values.
The unclamped 2D clipping gate ignores labels actually rendered by context-policy candidates.
Ownership validation checks declared changes but does not require every substantive changed source file to have a compatible owner and change.
Dependency-graph topology nodes union fact-specific physical targets at claim level and lose exact fact-to-target ownership.
The 844x390 focus key exceeds its real grid column in twenty-three sections and exposes horizontal scrolling while those compact views render no spatial labels.
Focused 2D route strokes project below one CSS pixel at compact and tablet viewports, weakening carrier and direction legibility in fifteen sections.
Hiding the Teaching control removes its grid cell and shifts the Next transport control into the wrong portrait slot in ten unannotated sections.
The s16-to-s17 cue promises path continuity even though the transition switches from the thermal subsystem to a grid-interconnection schedule with no shared topology.
The opening promises a five-stage delivery funnel but p0 and s20 substitute or duplicate statuses and omit constructed capacity.
The p1 objective promises carrier, direction, lifecycle, and evidence posture, but supplies no fixed legible grammar key and its projected base labels are unreadable at every audited viewport.
Round 6 recorded the combined challenger as rejected, but its exact comparison vector was not retained; no reproducible regression aggregate is claimed.
Release documentation names only three live gates and describes challenger approval as merely pending despite a rejected combined candidate and five mandatory final gates.
Final acceptance trusts a serialized Pareto disposition without deriving it from the coupled materiality, regression, gate, and blind-review evidence.
Frozen-champion verification accepts unknown top-level fields and can raise an untyped key error when required fields are replaced by extras.
Annotated nonportrait sections expose five in-flow transport children in a four-column grid, forcing Next into a second row that covers the modeled stage.
Every 844x390 focus key uses 7.5 px copy and 6 px indices below the project's 10 px legibility floor while the fit gate ignores font size.
The fixed 464 px portrait masthead exceeds the worst complete modeled requirement by 128.9 px and unnecessarily constrains every portrait visual stage.
Eleven 1024x768 focus keys retain a nowrap scrolling row and exceed the modeled first-column width by 48 to 334 px.
Fifteen evaluations across eight sections remain below the 0.08 occupancy review threshold and lack live scale and hierarchy confirmation.
P1's projected legend renders below 10 px at every viewport, while fallback grammar rows show no fixed line-style swatches and are numbered like geometry markers.
S09 occupancy-review prose carries stale values while the generated gate validates only evaluation identity and flags, not the recorded metric.
S17 frames a customer interconnection queue and administrative chronology even though the only customer-specific queue and contract record is explicitly unavailable.
S20 asserts one binding constraint and a causal stopped-at gate even though the evidence establishes staged statuses without a project critical path.
P0 displays 138 kV and 345 kV in two rating claims that bind only capacity facts, leaving the presented voltage values outside the exact claim chain.
P1 calls direction and evidence posture independent visual channels, but direction is stored only in invisible attributes and posture is conflated with lifecycle copy.
S24 names separate power and energy routes but never displays a worked unit cancellation to derive tokens per second or tokens.
The s18-to-s19 cue promises a construction-versus-load time-scale contrast, but neither visible teaching overlay carries the scoped 36-month and subsecond examples.
S01's fuel-to-shaft-to-generator-output objective is absent from its teaching annotation and the selected focus stops before the generator-output edge.
Scene and camera validators accept booleans and non-finite numerics, allowing canonical payloads to emit invalid JSON such as literal Infinity into the shared runtime.
Canonical ratchet, evidence, visuals, and champion contracts accept bool-int and int-float substitutions through Python equality and broad numeric checks.
Generated audit history replaces recorded round-time challenger dispositions with current decisions and points historical regression evidence at a mutable current object.
Focus-key indices remain 9 px at the wide, standard, and portrait viewports even though every section uses numbered geometry entries and the project floor is 10 px.
Every short-landscape opening question is 9 px, while the worst mastheads retain only 0.35 px modeled spare behind overflow clipping.
P1's twelve-entry desktop key remains a non-wrapping horizontally paged row whose estimated width exceeds both desktop masthead columns.
P1's mixed grammar and geometry key is named as numbered topology labels even though its first seven rows are intentionally unnumbered grammar cues.
The portrait CSS gives the direction row a two-column span while the estimator models one column, understating P1 by one row and 18 px.
S24's visible training derivation omits measured MFU, implying that peak FLOP per second alone converts to training tokens per second despite the bound recipe.
S17 and S18 promise dated gate comparisons while keeping most scoped dates out of the teaching frame, and S17 does not visibly delimit the unavailable private administrative record.
S16's heat-transfer synthesis retains the initial-fill node and fill-to-loop edge even though neither is a heat-transfer gate or an S16 teaching claim.
Master topology accepts extra fields, booleans, and unknown enums for node and edge posture, including values that crash shared runtime initialization.
Course and S10 pilot schema-version validators accept float and boolean values through Python equality coercion.
Evidence validation permits booleans in numeric units and numeric values in boolean units, allowing factual type changes to render as semantically false copy.
Round 6's exact aggregate regression claim points back to its own finding and the unretained round-time comparison vector cannot be independently recovered.
The S10 digest excludes its generator and transitive renderer code, so rendering changes can leave the embedded provenance digest unchanged.
At 844x390, the opened teaching overlays for P1 and S01 leave only 1.05 px above the stage boundary because containment is gated without a meaningful clearance floor.
Fact kind is derived only from the mutable unit, so coordinated value and unit replacement changes a qualified fact's semantic type without rejection.
Master node and edge records are exact, but root, metadata, reference/status blocks, and copy variants still accept unknown, missing, coercive, or mutually incompatible fields.
Closed topology enums are enforced independently, but valid enum combinations can promote evidence-free conceptual, variant, or terminal records to site_evidenced.
The central validator does not provide exact parity closure over eight deterministic SVG and S10 artifacts, allowing generated output tampering to pass the advertised project gate.
Camera validation accepts unknown fields and silently defaults away misspelled focus, map, and pulse ownership.
Protected experiment invariants omit act and segment objectives, so objective mutations remain invisible while the ratchet claims objectives are unchanged.
Evidence-bearing teaching and platform topology can be relabeled site-evidenced without changing its design-only, product, or explicitly unknown facts.
Camera viewBox, well, and map_view rectangles accept zero or negative dimensions that survive runtime compilation and static quality gates.
Camera annotations can describe unrelated nodes and focused edges need not have both endpoints in the camera's declared focus.
Registered populated numeric facts accept impossible negative physical quantities without changing identity, unit, kind, posture, or lifecycle.

The integrated compiler hardcodes every candidate acceptance gate pending while the manifest loader rejects resolved final acceptance evidence, so legitimate external review evidence cannot enter the acceptance path.
Three-dimensional geometry, fog, opacity, falsey repeat payloads, and browser-overflow numerics can remove or corrupt authored scene content while surviving runtime compilation.

Occupancy review records have neither a valid resolution path nor candidate-and-artifact binding, so live preferences cannot be ingested without enabling cross-candidate or arbitrary-reference promotion.
Coordinated source, fact, claim-wiring, and lifecycle mutations plus unvalidated generation entrypoints can promote evidence-backed unknowns into fabricated confirmed course content.

Candidate acceptance provenance is self-content-addressed but is not compared with the current source, generated-artifact, evidence, capture, accessibility, and review state, so fabricated internally consistent evidence can promote a challenger.
Exact source and fact contracts omit each evidence ledger's root subject and evidence-boundary posture, so coordinated weakening of all seven ledgers can survive validation and compilation.

Scene repeat counts, edge path cardinalities, and camera-state counts have no bounded per-record or total-expansion contract, so enormous inputs can survive validation and drive effectively unbounded builder and browser loops.

Scene and camera records do not enforce exact and nonempty root, nested, identity, and shape-specific schemas, so typos, empty structures, and falsy label-offset payloads can pass or escape typed failure while changing rendered output.
Direct runtime compilation and quality generation do not invoke authoritative scene validation, so invalid fog, geometry dimensions, node radii, and camera view boxes can reach generated registries.

Audit finding identifiers are unique only within a round and cross-round linkage collapses them to a set, so a repeated historical identifier can satisfy nominal one-to-one ownership and saturation checks.

Resolved occupancy reviews are candidate-routed and self-content-addressed but are not compared with a canonical current candidate, segment, and viewport capture manifest, so fabricated artifact hashes can pass.

Candidate current state derives only three generated artifacts from expected compiler output and treats the other thirteen retained files as current merely by hashing their disk bytes, so coordinated evidence can re-bless stale output.

Candidate current-state provenance excludes the quality source digest while its remaining runtime digest omits validation, quality, and ratchet implementation identity, so source-only contract changes do not stale acceptance evidence.

Individually finite repeat-step coordinates can overflow when multiplied by their repeat index or added to primitive positions, allowing infinite browser geometry through scene validation and direct compilation.

Occupancy capture identities are unique but their retained paths and hashes need not be, and artifact contents carry no independently checked identity, so one arbitrary file can approve every distinct review.

Scene validation treats every finite binary64 value as browser-renderable, but Three.js stores geometry in Float32BufferAttribute, so oversized finite geometry survives every compiler preflight and becomes Infinity in the actual renderer.
A capture is considered consumed whenever its candidate and evaluation key identify a detected occupancy risk, even when the corresponding review is unresolved and has no live evidence.

Candidate current state reuses canonical combined runtime and player artifacts for every isolated variant, so external evidence can accept a candidate whose retained browser artifact represents a different variant.
Complete audit rounds contain no audited-state digest, so two historical clean rounds can still declare saturation after later source, compiler, evidence, or artifact changes.

The upper Float32 headroom prevents Infinity but does not enforce lower or relative representability, and edge paths need not be nondegenerate, so sub-Float32 dimensions and intervals and zero-length paths survive every build gate and collapse in Three.js.
Float32-distinct edge endpoints can sit at a magnitude where the fixed TubeGeometry radius collapses on both cross-section axes, leaving every rendered triangle degenerate.
Primitive bounds are checked before authored rotation, so a thin rotated axis can move onto a high-magnitude world coordinate and collapse the mesh to zero volume after Float32 quantization.

A 3D camera anchor can remain syntactically valid while its declared focus geometry lies outside the authored frustum and fog range; the planned-shot anchor can remain blank after its controls clamp, while hybrid clamping and derived course framing mask the invalid authored state.
The 3D collision and clipping contract bounds a long nowrap label at 205 pixels while its fallback-font text exceeds the element's usable width, so visible text escapes the box used by layout checks.

Camera validation proves focus geometry is inside the frustum and fog but never tests depth occlusion by non-focus structures, so valid context geometry can cover every declared focus object while all validators and compilers pass.
The repaired 3D label model still uses average character width, so proportional-font wide glyphs can exceed the validated box and clip while every static gate passes.

Evaluate absolute collision, suppression, clipping, and 3D point gates across all 26 sections and five viewports.
